details: Adapter is found by scan; connect fails with universal_ble operationNotSupported (GATT 0x06 request not supported) on three devices, while ODMaster connects. Which step (subscribe ff21, handshake write ff22, MTU) is unknown; need the Bluetooth diagnostics report.
summary: Mobile connect fails "Operation Not Supported" on Android 8.1, Android 16 and iPadOS 17.7
